description: 長野市: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 長野市. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Nagano, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Nagano, Nagano Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Nagano, Nagano Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Translations. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 市街地循環ぐるりん号、篠ノ井ぐるりん号、東北ぐるりん号、若里更北線、川中島線、篠ノ井共和線、横田塩崎線、安茂里線、西長野・上松線、松代西条線、大室線、綿内線、長沼線、豊野３線、戸隠地区市営バス、鬼無里地区市営バス、大岡地区市営バス、赤柴線 It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
